assignment_hypothesis.statement: Cursor's documented worktree isolation properties hold under branch switching, concurrent writes, and controller-checkout guard tests.
assignment_hypothesis.support_condition: The assigned best-of-N run begins in a distinct worktree; worker branch switches and concurrent same-relative-path writes do not move or alter the controller checkout; and an occupied-branch or checkout-identity guard rejects collision.
assignment_hypothesis.falsification_condition: Any assigned run shares the controller toplevel, a worker branch switch moves the controller checkout, concurrent writes cross checkout boundaries, or an identity/occupied-branch guard permits the collision.

current_method_hypotheses.statement: A controller plus two distinct linked worktrees retain separate toplevels, HEAD/index state, branch identity, and tracked file bytes when one worker switches branches.
current_method_hypotheses.support_condition: Controller identity and tracked bytes are byte-equal before and after the worker switch while all three git dirs and toplevels are distinct.
current_method_hypotheses.falsification_condition: Controller toplevel, branch, HEAD, git-dir, index-visible state, or tracked bytes change as a result of the worker switch.
current_method_hypotheses.planned_test: Sanitized three-checkout repository reproduction in probe_worktree_isolation.py.

current_method_hypotheses.statement: Concurrent writes to the same relative path in different linked worktrees remain byte-isolated, and Git rejects a second checkout of a branch occupied by another worktree.
current_method_hypotheses.support_condition: Each worker retains only its own sentinel bytes, controller bytes remain unchanged, and the occupied-branch command exits nonzero with a worktree-occupancy diagnostic.
current_method_hypotheses.falsification_condition: Sentinel bytes cross between worktrees, controller bytes change, or the occupied branch is checked out without force.
current_method_hypotheses.planned_test: Synchronized dual-writer sanitized reproduction plus occupied-branch negative test.
